image.alt: A plate of Middle Palaeolithic flake tools - scrapers, borers and pointed flakes in yellow-brown, red, brown and green fine-grained stone - arranged in rows against a dark background.

types.alt: A second plate of Middle Palaeolithic flake tools, arranged so the steep-edged scrapers, pointed borers and slim projectile points can be told apart by shape.

point.alt: A single slim, sharply pointed stone flake lying beside a centimetre scale, small and light enough to balance on a fingertip.
